test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sujata is standing in a park facing the east direction. She then turns 135° anticlockwise. After that, she turns 90° anticlockwise. Then, she turns 45° clockwise. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sujata is standing in a park facing the east direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78ccd54ccabcfa2bfb66ddd722301d905f6d4b27bfbf34ae9cbfdbf3c96da583.png] 

2) She then turns 135° anticlockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/396a459f22d270c55a24d88cb907f6a818a53e9846cfd511f20c5d76d1a3e267.png] 

3) After that, she turns 90° anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f03b3fbeb31ac15f76db6c3e1c3235d15b6ad9bd4c6f263008583bda8d951d0.png] 

4) Then, she turns 45° clockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8100fa966fe5bad5932d9c5eb7ab60d7611887af59e9a82b765ebe4792cb222.png] 

Here, we can see that she is now facing West direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"West"**.
